name: Cable Crossover
summary: A standing cable fly that keeps constant tension on the chest as the handles are brought together in front of the body.
setup: Set both pulleys high and attach single handles.
Grab a handle in each hand and step forward into a staggered stance.
Lean slightly forward with a neutral spine and a soft bend in the elbows.
Start with arms open to the sides, hands about shoulder level or slightly lower.
execution: Brace your core and sweep the handles down and together in a wide arc in front of the chest.
Squeeze the chest at the point where the hands meet.
Reverse the arc slowly, letting the arms open until you feel a chest stretch.
Keep the elbow angle fixed and shoulders down throughout.
mistakes: Swinging the torso with momentum: lower the weight and stay steady.
Letting the elbows bend more as it gets hard (pressing): keep the angle fixed.
Overstretching with the shoulders pulled far back: stop where you feel the chest, not the front of the shoulder.
Weight stack slamming between reps: do not rest the stack; keep tension.
